literal: Battle having joined, having won, let grant king; home having joined, evening let us perform feast.
translation: Let the king engage in battle, win, and grant me leave. Then I shall return home and celebrate a feast this evening.
modern: அரசன் போரில் கலந்து கொண்டு வென்று எனக்கு விடை தரட்டும்; நான் என் மனைவியோடு சேர்ந்து இந்த மாலைப் பொழுதில் விருந்து கொண்டாடுவேன்.
explanation: The speaker, a soldier away on a military campaign, expresses his eager desire to return home. He wishes for the king to quickly engage in battle, secure victory, and grant him permission to leave. Once released, he anticipates reuniting with his wife at home and joyfully celebrating a feast together in the evening. The repetition of 'கலந்து' (having joined) elegantly contrasts the harsh joining of battle with the joyful joining of husband and wife.
